SpaceKnife 会退出并打开磁盘映像：把 SpaceKnife 拖进「应用: SpaceKnife quits and opens the disk image: drag SpaceKnife into the Applications folder to replace the old version.
SpaceKnife 会退出，并用系统的软件安装程序打开安装包；扫描数据和设置都: SpaceKnife quits and opens the package in the system's software installer. Scan data and settings are kept.
关闭（这个版本不再自动提示）: Close (this version won't be shown again by itself)
安装程序会关闭 SpaceKnife 并替换旧版本，扫描数据和设置都会保留: The installer closes SpaceKnife and replaces the old version. Scan data and settings are kept.
浏览器模式下无法安装更新: Updates can't be installed in browser mode
这个版本没有发布校验和，文件未经校验: This release publishes no checksums: the file was not verified
这种安装方式请到发布页下载: For this kind of install, download it from the release page
退出 SpaceKnife 后用新的 AppImage 替换旧文件；扫描数据和设: Quit SpaceKnife, then replace the old AppImage with the new one. Scan data and settings are kept.
退出 SpaceKnife 后解压，用新文件替换旧文件夹里的内容，但留下其中的: Quit SpaceKnife and unpack the archive, then replace the contents of the old folder but keep its data folder (it holds the scan data and settings).
还有扫描在进行，安装会中断它（已扫描的部分不会保存）: A scan is still running; installing stops it (what it has scanned so far is not saved).
